title: Jazzy Crispy Thai Chicken Satay
description: A herbal and crispy Thai dish featuring salsa and slow-cooked chicken, perfect for adventurous eaters, this recipe is also raw-friendly and can be served as a snack or appetizer.
instructions: Preheat the oven to 400 degrees Fahrenheit.
In a large bowl, whisk together coconut milk, peanut sauce, fish sauce, lime juice, garlic, ginger, and lemon grass.
Add the chicken strips to the bowl and marinate for at least 30 minutes.
Remove the chicken from the marinade and thread onto skewers.
Brush the skewers with vegetable oil and bake for 20 minutes or until cooked through.
While the chicken is cooking, heat the salsa in a saucepan over medium heat.
Once the chicken is done, brush with the heated salsa.
Serve the chicken satay hot with additional salsa and peanut sauce for dipping.
Garnish with fresh cilantro and lemon wedges if desired.
